title: Sky Harbour Announces Two New Hangar Campus Developments at Dallas Love Field (DAL) and Dallas Executive Airport (RBD) and Financing Updates
summary: BUSINESSWIRE: Sky Harbour Announces New Long Beach, California (LGB) Hangar Campus Development
body_markdown:
[BACK](https://skyharbour.group/news/)


### 12.11.25


Sky Harbour Group Corporation (NYSE: SKYH, SKYH WS) (“SHG” or the “Company”), an airport infrastructure company building the first nationwide network of Home Base Operator (HBO) campuses for business aircraft, today announced that the Dallas City Council voted to authorize the execution of ground lease agreements for the development of Sky Harbour HBO campuses at Dallas Love Field (DAL) and Dallas Executive Airport (RBD).


[Read Full Release](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251211971090/en/Sky-Harbour-Announces-Two-New-Hangar-Campus-Developments-at-Dallas-Love-Field-DAL-and-Dallas-Executive-Airport-RBD-and-Financing-Updates)
